ownerAuthority: The owner corrected the product target again: a recurring statement is not a useful Life Pattern merely because it repeats. A high-base-rate human regularity can be true while saying almost nothing about the individual. This establishes person-specific information as a participant-facing admission criterion. The deployed owner interview now triages clearly generic regularities before evidence collection, keeps uncertain/common-but-qualified candidates eligible, and retains the adaptive burden rules. The accepted v2 evidence semantics, target-theory blindness, privacy, participant authority, and access scope remain unchanged.
